Article Title: TOI's XI: The stars who lit up the FIFA World Cup 2026
Article Text:
Image credit: AP

Cristian Romero (ARG, Defender)

Pau Cubarsi (ESP, Defender)

Marc Cucurella (ESP, Defender)

(ARG, Forward)

(FRA, Forward)

SUBSTITUTES

The North American odyssey is over.Here are the stars who put their best foot forward.One of the tournament’s most attack-minded full-backs, Porro has balanced defensive discipline with constant overlapping runs. His accurate deliveries and relentless energy have given Spain width, while his recovery pace has helped neutralise dangerous wingers in the knockout games.Romero has been Argentina’s defensive warrior, combining aggression with intelligent positioning. The centre-back has thrived in highpressure knockout matches, making crucial interceptions and blocks while providing the steel behind Lionel Scaloni’s side as they played another World Cup final.Spain’s last line of defence has been calmness personified throughout the tournament. Simón has produced crucial saves in the knockout rounds while commanding a backline that has conceded just once. His composure, positioning and distribution have been instrumental in Spain’s march to the title.Still only a teenager, Cubarsi has played with remarkable maturity on the biggest stage.Calm under pressure and dominant in one-onone situations, the Barcelona defender has marshalled Spain’s defence with authority, helping champions La Roja boast the tournament’s stingiest backline.Has enjoyed outstanding World Cup, shutting down elite attackers while contributing in possession. Tireless up and down the left flank, he has combined defensive resilience with attacking support, earning widespread praise as one of Spain’s most consistent performers.Olise has emerged as France’s chief creator, dazzling with his dribbling, vision and precise final ball. His creativity has unlocked stubborn defences repeatedly, making him one of the tournament’s standout playmakers despite Les Bleus missing out on another World Cup final.The heartbeat of Spain’s midfield, Rodri has dictated the tempo with supreme composure. His interceptions, passing range and tactical intelligence have allowed Spain to dominate possession throughout. He has once again showed why he remains among football’s finest holding midfielders. He won the Golden Ball.England’s driving force in midfield, Bellingham has mixed elegance with relentless intensity. He has chipped in with vital goals, created chances and controlled games with maturity beyond his years, standing out despite England falling short of the World Cup final.At 39, Messi continues to redefine greatness. The Argentine captain has led from the front with decisive goals, assists and moments of brilliance, inspiring his side into a second successive World Cup final. His vision, composure and leadership have once again made him the game’s gold standard.Haaland announced Norway’s arrival among world football’s elite with a sensational tournament. His physical dominance, clinical finishing and relentless movement powered Norway into the quarterfinals. He staked his claim as the game’s leading marksman and the best in the No. 9 position.France’s biggest attacking threat once again, Mbappe has combined explosive pace with ruthless finishing till the semifinal. Whether scoring or creating, he has tormented defenders in every round and claimed the Golden Boot despite France’s semifinal exit.Masterminded Spain’s triumphant campaign with a fluid possession game, relentless highpressing and collective discipline. Having nurtured many players through Spain’s youth ranks, he built a cohesive unit that outplayed every opponent, proving once again that the strength of the team outweighed individual brilliance.Goalkeeper Defenders Forwards VOZINHA (CPV) ENZO FERNANDEZ (ARG) WILLIAM SALIBA (FRA) DANI OLMO (ESP) ACHRAF HAKIMI (MAR) MIKEL MERINO (ESP) HARRY KANE (ENG)
Article Summary: The North American odyssey is over. Here are the stars who put their best foot forward. Lionel Messi continues to redefine greatness. Kylian Mbappe has tormented defenders in every round. Erling Haaland has staked his claim as the game’s leading marksman.

Article Title: Chennai Grand Masters: Gukesh loses to Pranesh, Nihal Sarin wins
Article Text:
Nihal Sarin (Image credit: X)

CHENNAI: When you are in the middle of a bad patch, you walk into traps that even your opponents have not seen. D Gukesh is in that kind of a rut right now. He is just three Elo away from slipping below 2700 and is on just 1.5 points — and in last position — after six rounds of the Chennai GM chess tournament.The youngest-ever world champion at 18, the 20-year-old lost his second successive game against an Indian compatriot, this time to the lowest-rated player of the eight-player event, M Pranesh (Elo 2666).Gukesh, who is now world No. 31, got into promising positions against both Arjun in the previous round and against Pranesh but fumbled in the heat of the battle.The other match-up of the day involving both Indians also ended decisively as Nihal Sarin defeated overnight leader Erigaisi Arjun with one round to go.This opened up a three-way title race among Arjun, Alireza Frirouzja and Nodirbek Abdusattorov after the day’s other two games. Pranesh had beaten Gukesh for the first time in the state U-7 meet in Trichy in 2013.
Article Summary: D Gukesh loses his second successive game against an Indian compatriot. The 20-year-old is now just three Elo away from slipping below 2700. Nihal Sarin defeated overnight leader Erigaisi Arjun with one round to go.

Article Title: Harmanpreet Singh to lead full-strength India at FIH Men's World Cup
Article Text:
Harmanpreet Singh

The squad:

BENGALURU : Hockey India on Tuesday named a full-strength 20-member team for the FIH men’s World Cup in the Netherlands and Belgium next month, despite talk that India would send a ‘second’ team. “If you ever underestimate a World Cup and the opportunity to play in it, then that’s at your own peril. It is the 50-year anniversary of the last time India won this tournament. We have real aspirations of doing well,” chief coach Craig Fulton told TOI .The team has been under the scanner after a below-par performance in the Australian leg of the FIH Pro League, losing both matches to Spain and recording a loss and a win in shootouts against Australia. They bounced back with wins against Germany, the Netherlands, England and Pakistan.Admitting it was a difficult phase for the team, Fulton said it was important to cut out the noise and move forward.“You have to be realistic about what phase you’re in. So every time we play in Feb, it’s the phase after six weeks of Hockey India League. That’s a challenging time for the players. I know that next time we’ll be selecting a younger group (for Pro League) and we’ll leave our seniors to rest,” the South African said.The team, to be led by Harmanpreet Singh, will mark a major global tournament for two players – goalkeeper HS Mohith and midfielder Aditya Lalage.Goalkeepers: Mohith HS, Suraj Karkera; Defenders: Jarmanpreet Singh, Harmanpreet Singh (c), Amit Rohidas, Jugraj Singh, Sanjay, Sumit, Yashdeep Siwach; Midfielders: Rajinder Singh, Aditya Lalage, Hardik Singh, Manpreet Singh, Nilakanta Sharma, Vivek Sagar Prasad; Forwards: Dilpreet Singh, Shilanand Lakra, Sukhjeet Singh, Mandeep Singh, Abhishek.
Article Summary: Hockey India name a full-strength 20-member team for the FIH men’s World Cup in the Netherlands and Belgium next month. The team has been under the scanner after a below-par performance in the Australian leg of FIH Pro League. They bounced back with wins against Germany, the Netherlands, England and Pakistan.

Article Title: Whopping Rs 9.6 crore! FIFA World Cup final's most expensive seats goes viral for blocked view
Article Text:
PTI Photo

Spain beat Argentina to win FIFA World Cup 2026



NEW DELHI: The FIFA World Cup 2026 final between Argentina and Spain at the New York New Jersey Stadium offered one of the most expensive tickets in sports history.FIFA's official hospitality partner, On Location, installed 12 luxury cinema-style seats right on the edge of the pitch. Each seat reportedly cost an whopping $1 million (approx INR 9.64 crore), as reported by Sport Bible.The seats gave fans a close-up view of stars like Lionel Messi and Lamine Yamal, but many were left surprised after photos of the setup appeared online.Despite the huge price tag, the view from the seats was far from perfect. A thick glass barrier and photographers standing in front of the seats meant fans had an obstructed view for large parts of the match. The seats were also placed on the sunny side of the stadium, although buyers were given free sun hats.Shortly before kick-off, SportBible shared pictures of the luxury seating area."The view from the $1 million on-the-pitch seats sold by hospitality provider On Location for the FIFA World Cup Final at MetLife Stadium. It’s on the sunny side of the stadium, so sunhats are included," a SportBible journalist wrote.The pictures quickly went viral on social media.Substitute Ferran Torres scored the winning goal in extra time as Spain defeated defending champions Argentina 1-0 in the FIFA World Cup 2026 final at the jam-packed New York New Jersey Stadium.After a hard-fought 90 minutes ended without a goal, Torres broke the deadlock in the 106th minute. Nico Williams headed the ball into his path, and the Spain forward fired a powerful left-footed shot past Argentina goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez to seal the biggest win of his career.The victory gave Spain their second FIFA World Cup title and their first since lifting the trophy in South Africa in 2010.
Article Summary: FIFA's official hospitality partner, On Location, installed 12 luxury cinema- style seats right on the edge of the pitch. Each seat reportedly cost an whopping $1 million (approx INR 9.64 crore) Despite the huge price tag, the view from the seats was far from perfect.

Article Title: Indian hockey players head Down Under for Hockey One stint
Article Text:
Kanika Siwach (left) and Udita

Kolkata: Even as the Indian men’s and women’s hockey teams prepare for the upcoming World Cup and the Asian Games, a group of players outside the current national set-up has signed up to play in Australia’s Hockey One league, scheduled to be held in Oct and Nov.So far, four Indian players have officially announced their participation, all of them set to represent Melbourne Cobras franchise. The women’s contingent comprises Kanika Siwach and Udita, while Gurjant Singh and Mohammed Raheel Mouseen will feature in the men’s team. The club has also roped in former India stars Rupinder Pal Singh and Rani Rampal as ambassadors.The Cobras have been actively promoting the Indian community in Australia and have built a squad that blends Indian and Australian talent.Speaking about her decision, Kanika, daughter of former India captain and coach Pritam Siwach, said she wanted to challenge herself by stepping away from the familiarity of home.“I wanted to step out of my comfort zone. Back home, I had been with the same players for five or six years. Here, I didn’t know anyone. I had to adapt to a new culture, new teammates and a completely different environment. I wanted to test myself, and that’s why I came.”Kanika, who played in the junior World Cup last year and scored five goals, has already spent more than a month in Australia and is currently playing in the Women’s Premier League for Mentone Hockey Club.Reflecting on the experience so far, she said, “Australian hockey is very different from Indian hockey. It’s much more physical and fast-paced. They also place a huge emphasis on teamwork. In India, we focus a lot on developing individual skills, whereas here everything is more structured and team-oriented.”Udita, who has represented India in 138 internationals and last played for the national team in the Women’s World Cup Qualifiers in Hyderabad earlier this year, is equally excited about the opportunity.“Our Hockey India League is relatively short, lasting about 20 to 25 days, whereas the Australian league runs for nearly two months. That means we’ll be immersed in hockey for much longer and get to observe their training habits, routines and overall approach.”Former India drag-flicker Rupinder Pal Singh believes the stint will be invaluable for the Indian players, given the limited opportunities they get to feature in overseas leagues.“Indian players don’t often get the chance to play in international leagues, so this is a valuable opportunity,” said the former India player. “It will allow our players to experience Australian hockey culture first-hand, observe how they prepare, and learn from their training methods.”This exposure, Rupinder believes, could prove invaluable as Indian players return home with fresh ideas, different perspectives and a better understanding of one of the world’s strongest hockey systems.
Article Summary: Kanika Siwach and Udita will play for Melbourne Cobras in Hockey One league. Gurjant Singh and Mohammed Raheel Mouseen will feature in the men’s team. The club has also roped in former India stars Rupinder Pal Singh and Rani Rampal.

Article Title: India at CWG 2026: Know Your Athlete - ​​Neeru Pathak (Athletics)
Article Text: Event: Women's 400 metres, Mixed 4 x 400 metres relayCWG Record: The 19-year-old Indian sprinter earned her first-ever selection to the Indian athletics contingent for the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow.Personal bests: 52.78 in Women's 400 metres, 3:17.06 in Mixed 4 x 400 metres relayNeeru Pathak will be one of the youngest members of India's athletics team at the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow. Competing against experienced international athletes will provide another opportunity to test herself at the highest level. With strong performances in junior competitions and a place in India's relay squad, Neeru will look to make the most of her first Commonwealth Games appearance and continue her development on the international stage.

Article Title: Bhola elected Hockey Jharkhand president for fourth term on trot
Article Text:
Bhola Nath Singh

Kolkata: Hockey India secretary general Bhola Nath Singh was on Sunday elected unopposed as Hockey Jharkhand president for a fourth consecutive term during the association’s 13th Annual General Meeting in Ranchi.The election, however, comes amid a legal challenge over Singh’s eligibility to continue in office.The National Sports Governance Act, 2025 states that “a person may continuously hold the position of either the president or the secretary general or the treasurer, as the case may be, for up to three consecutive terms separately, or in combination thereof”.Hockey Jharkhand, however, maintained that Singh’s re-election was in accordance with the National Sports Policy 2025, which Hockey India has implemented.In its official release, the association stated that “owing to being an office-bearer in an international sports federation, Bhola Nath Singh was elected Hockey Jharkhand president for a fourth consecutive time”.Besides serving as Hockey Jharkhand president and Hockey India secretary general, Singh has also been the vice-president of the Asian Hockey Federation (AHF) since his election to the post in March 2023.Meanwhile, Manoj Kumar Prasad was elected unopposed as general secretary, while Asrita Lakra was elected treasurer.The development comes days after a group of 13 former international and national hockey players served a legal notice to Hockey Jharkhand and the Jharkhand Sports Department, questioning the legality of the election process. Several of the petitioners including Sumrai Tete, along with former India women’s captain Asunta Lakra, staged a peaceful protest outside the venue carrying placards, but did not make any public statements.During the AGM, Hockey Jharkhand also ratified its annual accounts and reports for 2025-26 and distributed sports kits worth ₹65,000 each to 20 districts as part of its grassroots development programme.
Article Summary: Bhola Nath Singh was on Sunday elected unopposed as Hockey Jharkhand president for a fourth consecutive term. The election, however, comes amid a legal challenge over Singh’s eligibility to continue in office. Singh has also been the vice-president of the Asian Hockey Federation (AHF) since his election to the post in March 2023.

Article Title: 5th ODI: Shimron Hetmyer holds nerve as West Indies edge New Zealand by two wickets
Article Text:
Shimron Hetmyer (Photo by @windiescricket on X)

New Zealand's strong start goes in vain

West Indies ended the ODI series on a high with a thrilling two-wicket win over New Zealand in the fifth and final match, successfully chasing 269 with 15 balls to spare.Although New Zealand had already sealed the five-match series 3-2, the hosts finished strongly thanks to an unbeaten 69 from Shimron Hetmyer and a crucial 95-run partnership with Sherfane Rutherford, who scored 61.After losing both openers early, West Indies recovered through Shai Hope (39) and Keacy Carty (20), before Rutherford and Hetmyer took control of the chase.The match swung several times as Rutherford, Gudakesh Motie, Matthew Forde and Alzarri Joseph fell in quick succession, leaving West Indies under pressure with 21 runs still needed.However, Hetmyer stayed calm and struck two crucial sixes to steer his side home. Reflecting on his match-winning knock, he said: “I wasn't really thinking about getting a half-century to be honest, I was just thinking about how ... I can make sure the team crosses the line. Every time a new batter came out I was just like ‘make sure you’re there at the end.' I'm just happy that I could be there to make sure we crossed the line. ”Earlier, New Zealand posted 268/9 after useful contributions from Tom Latham (69), Nick Kelly (64) and Will Young (56).The visitors looked set for a bigger total at one stage but were pulled back by disciplined West Indies bowling, with Alzarri Joseph finishing with 2/38.Spinner Jayden Lennox was New Zealand's standout bowler, taking 3/35 in the final match. He finished the series with 14 wickets at an average of 13.6 and was named Player of the Series, though his efforts were not enough to stop West Indies from ending the contest with a morale-boosting victory.
Article Summary: West Indies beat New Zealand by two wickets in the fifth and final ODI. Shimron Hetmyer scored an unbeaten 69 as West Indies won with 15 balls to spare. New Zealand had already sealed the five-match series 3-2.

Article Title: ISL participation: Jamshedpur FC seek more time
Article Text: PANAJI: Jamshedpur FC have sought an extension till July 31 to decide on participation in the Indian Super League (ISL) under the competition's new club-led structure.The AIFF had asked all 14 clubs to confirm participation and pay the first instalment of Rs 55 lakh by July 20. While all clubs confirmed participation, Inter Kashi only conveyed an “in-principle willingness” to join and sought more time for payment.In a letter to AIFF deputy secretary general M Satyanarayan, Jamshedpur CEO Mukul Choudhari said the revised commercial framework requires shareholder approval and additional compliance procedures as the club’s parent entity is linked to a listed company.Inter Kashi requested permission to pay cumulative fees by Aug 14, citing operational constraints. Although AIFF had earlier ruled out extensions, sources indicated the federation could wait until July 31.
Article Summary: Jamshedpur FC have sought an extension till July 31 to decide on participation in the Indian Super League (ISL) under the competition's new club-led structure. The AIFF had asked all 14 clubs to confirm participation and pay the first instalment of Rs 55 lakh by July 20.

Article Title: Days after retiring, Ben Stokes marks new chapter with match-winning century
Article Text:
Ben Stokes (Image credit: X)

Stokes battles cramp



Emotional farewell



NEW DELHI: Just days after retiring from international cricket, Ben Stokes showed he still has plenty left in the tank. Playing his first match as a former England cricketer, Stokes scored an unbeaten 108 to guide Durham to a five-wicket win over Derbyshire in the One-Day Cup at Derby.The century came in Stokes' first 50-over match for Durham in 12 years. Before his match-winning knock, he also bowled nine economical overs, finishing with figures of 0/38.Chasing 257, Durham were in trouble at 98/3 before Stokes anchored the innings with an unbeaten 108 off 123 balls. His knock included 10 fours and three sixes as Durham reached 257/5 in 49.1 overs, winning with five balls to spare.Despite struggling with cramp for much of his innings, Stokes stayed till the end to complete his century and take Durham home.Kasey Aldridge remained unbeaten on 23, while Will Rhodes scored 45 and Colin Ackermann added 28.Earlier, Derbyshire posted 256/9 in 50 overs. Martin Andersson top-scored with 112, while Brooke Guest made 48. Luke Robinson was Durham's best bowler with 3/44.A few days before his century, Stokes had announced his retirement from international cricket following England's third Test against New Zealand. Soon after, he shared an emotional message on X, thanking everyone who had been part of his journey."It's been a mad 15 years. It's had everything thrown in there, from the highest highs to the lowest lows (on and off the field). My time was up, and no one was going to be able to make that decision other than me. But in the meantime, I just want to say I love every single England fan and every single cricket fan who's supported me over the years," Stokes wrote.He also thanked his teammates and everyone who supported him throughout his career."I love every single person I've walked out onto the field with representing England. I could go on and on, but I hope you get the gist of how much I loved doing what I did for 15 years. I'm looking forward to being a fan and supporting the team, and the odd day in hospitality won't go amiss. Family, friends, teammates, fans...I love y'all. Stokesy," he added.Stokes finished his international career with 122 Tests, including 44 as captain, scoring more than 7,000 runs and taking over 200 wickets. He also represented England in 114 ODIs and 43 T20Is.
Article Summary: Ben Stokes scores unbeaten 108 to guide Durham to a five-wicket win over Derbyshire. The century came in Stokes' first 50-over match for Durham in 12 years. Before his match-winning knock, he also bowled nine economical overs, finishing with figures of 0/38.

Article Title: Phoebe Litchfield's 43, Deepti Sharma's 2-fer power Sunrisers Leeds to seven-wicket win over MI London
Article Text:
Sunrisers Leeds Women beat MI London Women by 7 wickets (Image: Cricbuzz/x)

MI London squander strong start after Deepti Sharma 's brilliance



Phoebe Litchfield anchors comfortable chase



Upcoming Fixtures for MI London and Sunrisers Leeds

Match Date Time (Local / IST) Venue Sunrisers Leeds Women vs Southern Brave Women Saturday, July 25, 2026 11:00 AM Local / 3:30 PM IST Headingley, Leeds Welsh Fire Women vs MI London Women Saturday, July 25, 2026 2:30 PM Local / 7:00 PM IST Sophia Gardens, Cardiff

The Hundred 2026 got underway in style as defending champions Sunrisers Leeds Women (formerly Northern Superchargers) began their campaign with a commanding seven-wicket victory over MI London Women (formerly Oval Invincibles) at The Kia Oval, London on Tuesday.After producing a disciplined bowling display to restrict MI London to 107/8, Sunrisers Leeds chased down the target comfortably with seven wickets and 31 balls to spare, thanks to a match-winning knock from Phoebe Litchfield, who was named Player of the Match for her unbeaten 43 off 26 balls.MI London looked set for a much bigger total after openers Hayley Matthews and Danni Wyatt-Hodge gave the side a flying start. The pair powered the innings to 50 without loss in just 34 balls, while MI London were well placed at 68/1 after 50 balls.However, Sunrisers Leeds fought back brilliantly through their bowlers. Indian all-rounder Deepti Sharma triggered the collapse with figures of 2/20, applying the brakes in the middle phase. Captain Dani Gibson also struck twice at crucial moments as MI London lost momentum, slipping from a commanding position to finish on just 107/8 from their 100 balls.Chasing a modest target of 108, Sunrisers Leeds suffered a couple of early setbacks but never lost control of the chase. Australian batter Phoebe Litchfield played the defining innings, remaining composed while keeping the scoreboard moving. Her fluent 43 off 26 deliveries ensured the defending champions crossed the finish line with ease, sealing a seven-wicket victory and earning her the Player of the Match award.
Article Summary: Defending champions Sunrisers Leeds Women beat MI London Women by seven wickets at The Kia Oval, London on Tuesday. Article Title: 'I can hit from ball one': Tilak Varma hits back at strike-rate criticism ahead of Zimbabwe tour
Article Text:
Tilak Varma responds to criticism (Image: ANI)

'I can hit from ball one, but I play according to the situation'



'The team's plan comes before personal numbers'



Strike rate of 131 in UK Tour

Match Runs (Balls) Strike Rate vs Ireland – 1st T20I 19 (21) 90.48 vs Ireland – 2nd T20I 55 (46) 119.57 vs England – 1st T20I 13 (13) 100.00 vs England – 2nd T20I 24* (11) 218.18 vs England – 3rd T20I 3 (11) 27.27 vs England – 4th T20I 11 (8) 137.50 vs England – 5th T20I 53 (25) 212.00

India's T20I vice-captain Tilak Varma has hit back at criticism surrounding his strike rate during the recent T20I tours of Ireland and England, insisting that he always bats according to the team's requirements rather than personal milestones.The left-hander faced scrutiny after scoring 178 runs in seven T20Is across the two tours at a strike rate of 131.85. While he registered two half-centuries 55 against Ireland in the second T20I and 53 against England in the fifth and final T20I questions were raised over his approach in the middle overs.However, ahead of India's T20I series against Zimbabwe, Tilak made it clear that he is capable of attacking from the very first ball but chooses his approach based on the match situation and the team's needs.Explaining his batting philosophy, Tilak said adapting to different batting positions and overseas conditions required him to take responsibility rather than chase an aggressive strike rate."In this game, you have to bat in different positions, and especially in those conditions, it isn't easy. At the same time, I've always said that I do whatever the team requires. If I have to grind it out for the team, I'll do that.If I have to hit from ball one, I can do that as well," Tilak told reporters during the pre-match press conference.The 23-year-old pointed out that India's repeated top-order collapses on the Ireland and England tours forced the middle order to rebuild the innings instead of playing freely."From Ireland to England, we were losing four or five wickets inside the powerplay or within the first 10 overs in several matches. Going in and trying to accelerate immediately in that situation doesn't make sense. That's always in my mind. I know I can hit the first ball, but I'm playing for the country, and that comes with responsibilities," he added.Tilak further revealed that as India's vice-captain, he is entrusted with specific responsibilities by the team management and prefers to execute those plans rather than focus on individual statistics."Everything depends on what the team needs at that moment. Sometimes I have to bat till the end, and sometimes the team's plans change according to the match situation. As vice-captain, the management gives me certain responsibilities after careful planning, and I want to fulfil those responsibilities. That's why I play according to the team's plans," Tilak said.Tilak Varma finished the 2026 UK and Ireland tour with an overall T20I strike rate of 131.85, scoring 178 runs off 135 balls faced. While his tour featured highly explosive cameos, such as a blistering 212.00 strike rate (53 runs off 25 balls) in the final T20I at Southampton.
Article Summary: Tilak Varma hit back at criticism surrounding his strike rate during recent T20I tours of Ireland and England. The left-hander faced scrutiny after scoring 178 runs in seven T20Is across the two tours at a strike rate of 131.85. The 23-year-old said adapting to different batting positions and overseas conditions required him to take responsibility.

Article Title: 'Conditions were challenging': Tilak Varma reveals what went wrong for India in Ireland and England
Article Text:
India's T20I vice-captain Tilak Varma

'England conditions were a big challenge'

'Results will come and go, we need to stay positive'



India's tour of Zimbabwe

Match Date Time (IST) Venue 1st T20I Thursday, July 23 4:30 PM Harare Sports Club, Harare 2nd T20I Saturday, July 25 4:30 PM Harare Sports Club, Harare 3rd T20I Sunday, July 26 4:30 PM Harare Sports Club, Harare

Team India's T20I vice-captain Tilak Varma has reflected on the challenges that contributed to India's disappointing back-to-back T20I series defeats against Ireland and England, insisting the team remains focused on learning from the setbacks and regaining momentum.The reigning T20 World Cup champions endured a forgettable tour of the British Isles in July 2026, managing just one win across the entire trip of 10 matches while suffering consecutive bilateral series defeats to Ireland and England. India also failed to register a single victory in the T20I leg of the tour.Ahead of India's upcoming T20I series against Zimbabwe, Tilak admitted that adapting to overseas conditions after playing predominantly in Asia over the past two years proved to be a major challenge. He also backed captain Shreyas Iyer , highlighting the importance of staying calm under pressure and maintaining a positive environment within the squad."Honestly, Shreyas Iyer is leading a champion team, so obviously there's always responsibility. At the same time, Ireland and England offered completely different conditions. For the last two years, we've mostly been playing in Asia, and then suddenly we had to compete in overseas conditions against a very strong England side, whom we had already seen in the World Cup semi-final. Playing against such a quality team in challenging conditions was always going to be difficult, and naturally there were expectations as well," Tilak said in a video shared by the BCCI on X.The left-handed batter stressed that the team has taken valuable lessons from the tour and is determined to bounce back by creating the right atmosphere within the dressing room."In those situations, you have to remain calm under pressure and create positive energy within the team. That's our mindset. Results will go up and down, but what's important is how we build a good environment and back every individual. It's just a matter of one match or one series. The last series was a good learning experience, and now we want to execute those learnings and bring back the momentum," he added.
Article Summary: India's T20I vice-captain Tilak Varma has reflected on the challenges that contributed to India's disappointing back-to-back series defeats against Ireland and England. Article Title: Justin Langer frontrunner for England coach job; Ravi Shastri, Rahul Dravid not in the race
Article Text:
Former Australia cricketer and coach Justin Langer poses for a photograph with the Waterford Crystal trophy. (Reuters File)

TimesofIndia.com in London:

Former Australia opener and coach Justin Langer has emerged as the leading contender to become England's next Test head coach after Brendon McCullum was sacked from the role last week.Langer is understood to be at the top of the England and Wales Cricket Board's (ECB) shortlist. However, it remains to be seen how his commitments with the Lucknow Super Giants (LSG) in the Indian Premier League (IPL) and the Manchester Super Giants in The Hundred. Strong indications suggest Langer could part ways with LSG and discussions with the ECB will unfold in the coming days.TimesofIndia.com also understands that former India head coaches Ravi Shastri and Rahul Dravid are not in contention for the role. While both highly respected figures were briefly linked with the vacancy, neither is part of the ECB's current recruitment process.The ECB is aiming to appoint a new coach before England's home Test series against Pakistan begins next month, with Langer firmly in pole position if contractual hurdles can be resolved.Earlier, Andy Flower, who is currently coaching London Spirit in The Hundred and guided Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) to back-to-back IPL titles, ruled himself out of the race.Langer took over as Lucknow Super Giants head coach in 2023 after succeeding Flower.He also coaches Manchester Super Giants in The Hundred. If approached by the ECB, he will have to decide whether to accept the England role and leave his franchise commitments, remain exclusively in franchise cricket, or attempt to balance both responsibilities. Flower faced a similar choice and opted to continue in franchise cricket.McCullum finished his tenure as England's Test coach with a record of 27 wins, two draws and 20 defeats. England's form dipped sharply towards the end of his stint, with the team losing seven of its last nine Tests. His tenure both began and ended with home series against his native New Zealand. It started with a commanding 3-0 sweep in 2022 and concluded with a series defeat last month."I've absolutely loved coaching the Test side and I'm incredibly proud of what we've achieved together," McCullum had said after being sacked."There have been some unbelievable highs and a few tough days along the way, but that's all part of taking on a challenge like this. It's been a privilege and an honour, and I'm grateful. Grateful to the players, the staff and the fans who supported us on the journey."I wish the Test team nothing but success. There's a hell of a lot of talent in that dressing room and they're a special bunch of lads. I'll always be backing the boys, with a smile on my face, and hoping they keep taking the game on. I know they'll continue to make people proud."
Article Summary: Justin Langer has emerged as the leading contender to become England's next Test head coach. Brendon McCullum was sacked from the role last week. Former India head coaches Ravi Shastri and Rahul Dravid are not in contention for the role.

Article Title: Argentina players turned their backs during Spain's FIFA World Cup celebrations; video goes viral - WATCH

There were scuffles, heated arguments and even an apparent shove by the throat as tempers flared between players.The bad blood carried over into the trophy ceremony, where several Argentina players turned their backs while Spain celebrated with the World Cup trophy.After collecting their silver medals from FIFA president Gianni Infantino and US President Donald Trump, Argentina's players refused to watch Spain celebrate.Instead, they stood facing their supporters with their backs to the podium as Spain collected their gold medals and lifted the World Cup trophy.The video of the incident has since gone viral on social media.The trophy ceremony followed chaotic scenes on the pitch moments after Spain sealed victory.Video footage showed Argentina midfielder Leandro Paredes appearing to shove Spain defender Eric Garcia by the throat during a heated confrontation.When Spain substitute Gavi stepped in to separate the players, Paredes appeared to push him to the ground.Spain captain Rodri also appeared to be struck in the stomach by Argentina defender Nahuel Molina before Molina and Nicolas Otamendi confronted the midfielder during a tense verbal exchange.Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni and several players rushed in to calm the situation before it escalated further.Following the ugly scenes, FIFA confirmed it has opened an investigation into the incidents.In a statement, FIFA said its "disciplinary committee has appointed a Disciplinary and Ethics Prosecutor to investigate potential breaches of the (FIFA disciplinary code) with regard to the post-match incidents."
Article Summary: Spain defeated Argentina 1-0 to lift the FIFA World Cup 2026 title at the New York New Jersey Stadium. Article Title: Were Argentina under more pressure than usual in World Cup final? Lionel Messi's tunnel pep talks fuel fan theories – WATCH

Messi's repeated message raises questions



Half-time rally alongside Emiliano Martinez



Emotional aftermath

Fresh footage of Lionel Messi 's pre-match and half-time team talks has reignited debate over whether Argentina entered the 2026 FIFA World Cup final carrying more baggage than just the weight of defending their title.The newly surfaced videos, recorded inside the dressing room and players' tunnel before Sunday's final against Spain, have prompted widespread fan speculation after Messi repeatedly urged his teammates to "forget everything" and focus solely on football.The footage has gone viral after Argentina produced one of their most subdued performances under Lionel Scaloni, eventually losing 0-1 after extra time to Spain at MetLife Stadium.While Spain dominated proceedings throughout, Argentina failed to register a meaningful attacking threat for long periods, with their first shot arriving only deep into extra time.The first video, filmed moments before the players left the dressing room, shows Messi attempting to calm an unusually tense-looking squad."Calm, let's stay calm, lads. Let's think about playing, nothing else. Stay calm. Let's forget about everything, let's forget about everything.Let's focus on playing," the Argentina captain told his teammates.Another clip from the tunnel captures Messi delivering a similar message moments before kick-off."Come on, boys, let's forget what happened, as if nothing had happened," Messi was heard telling his teammates.The wording immediately caught the attention of supporters, particularly because several players — including Lisandro Martinez and Enzo Fernandez — appeared visibly emotional and unusually subdued.Martinez was later forced off injured during the first half, while Fernandez was sent off late in normal time after receiving a second yellow card.Messi's leadership continued during the interval as television cameras picked up another motivational speech before Argentina returned for the second half."Come on, lads. Personality, people, personality. We've always had it, so why wouldn't we have it now? Let's move forward, not backward... Only cowards play backward."Despite the rallying cries, Argentina struggled to impose themselves before Ferran Torres eventually scored the winner in the 106th minute.The unusual nature of Messi's comments has triggered numerous theories on social media. Messi's repeated plea to "forget everything" remains unexplained.

Article Title: 'World Cup lost its credibility': Sepp Blatter says politics overshadowed football after 'right champions' Spain's triumph
Article Text:
L-R: FIFA president Gianni Infantino and US President Donald Trump present the trophy to Spain's Rodri; and Sepp Blatter.

Politics and controversies dominate tournament discussion



Infantino celebrates success despite criticism



Former FIFA president Sepp Blatter has launched a scathing attack on football's governing body in the aftermath of the 2026 FIFA World Cup , claiming the tournament "lost its credibility" and urging fans, players and national associations to reclaim the sport from political influence.Blatter's strongly worded message came just two days after Spain defeated defending champions Argentina 1-0 after extra time to lift their second World Cup title, bringing the first-ever 48-team World Cup to a close.While acknowledging Spain as deserving champions, the 90-year-old Swiss did not hold back in his assessment of the tournament's wider legacy.Taking to X, Blatter wrote: "The longest World Cup has come to an end – with the right champions. But on the way to the final whistle, the tournament had lost its credibility. Politics must not be allowed to overshadow the game."He concluded with an even stronger appeal directed at football's stakeholders."Now it is up to the fans, players and national associations to reclaim football and bring it back to its roots under new leadership," he added.The post also tagged FIFA, the World Cup, the controversial FIFA halftime show, Donald Trump and current FIFA president Gianni Infantino, underlining who Blatter believes should be at the centre of the debate.Blatter has been one of the most vocal critics of FIFA's direction under Infantino, and his latest remarks reflect growing scrutiny over the intersection of football and politics during the expanded tournament.The 2026 edition, jointly hosted by the United States, Canada and Mexico, was the biggest in World Cup history, featuring 48 teams, 104 matches across 16 venues over more than a month.Although the football itself received widespread praise, several off-field controversies dominated headlines throughout the tournament.Political tensions surrounding Iran's participation, visa disputes, travel restrictions affecting supporters from several nations, debate over immigration policies, concerns about extreme summer heat and criticism of FIFA's growing commercialisation all fuelled discussion during the competition.The relationship between US President Donald Trump and FIFA president Gianni Infantino also came under intense scrutiny, particularly after Balogun's suspension was lifted ahead of the United States' Round of 16 clash.Despite the criticism, FIFA has described the tournament as one of the most successful in history.Infantino highlighted record attendance figures of nearly seven million spectators, while estimating that more than six billion viewers watched the tournament worldwide.Television audiences also remained strong. Spanish-language broadcaster Telemundo reported that the Spain-Argentina final attracted a preliminary audience of 22.6 million, putting it on course to become the most-watched World Cup final in Spanish-language television history.Attendance across the United States, Canada and Mexico also exceeded expectations despite concerns over ticket prices and logistics.On the field, the expanded 48-team format largely silenced fears that the competition would become diluted. Surprise packages such as Cape Verde and Congo enjoyed memorable campaigns before the tournament ultimately delivered heavyweight semi-finals featuring Spain, Argentina, France and England.
Article Summary: Former FIFA president Sepp Blatter hits out at football's governing body. Blatter says the 2026 World Cup "lost its credibility" The 90-year-old urges fans, players and national associations to reclaim the sport from political influence. FIFA has described the tournament as one of the most successful in history.

Article Title: 'It's embarrassing': Argentina's World Cup final conduct under fresh scrutiny after viral clip emerges
Article Text:
Argentina players protest after Argentina's Enzo Fernandez (24) was shown a red card (AP Photo)

Argentina's FIFA World Cup final defeat to Spain has come under renewed scrutiny after new footage surfaced on social media appearing to show an attempt to influence the aftermath of Enzo Fernandez's decisive red card.Lionel Scaloni's side lost 1-0 after extra time at New York New Jersey Stadium, with Ferran Torres scoring the winner in the 106th minute to hand Spain their second World Cup title. However, much of the post-match discussion has centred on Argentina's conduct during and after the final.The latest clip focuses on the incident that saw Fernandez dismissed in second-half stoppage time. Just days after netting the winner against England in the semi-finals, the Chelsea midfielder endured a frustrating evening, receiving a second yellow card in the 93rd minute following a late challenge on Spain defender Pau Cubarsi.Fernandez immediately protested the decision, but replays showed the tackle left little doubt over the referee's call.Fresh footage circulating online has added another layer to the controversy. The video appears to show Argentina full-back Nicolas Tagliafico standing unchallenged near Spain's penalty area before suddenly clutching his ankle and falling to the ground moments after Fernandez committed the foul.Seconds earlier, Tagliafico had been walking normally, with no Spain player in close proximity.The same footage also captures Lionel Messi rushing towards referee Slavko Vincic immediately after the red card was shown. The Argentina captain pointed towards the grounded Tagliafico, seemingly attempting to draw the referee's attention to the incident. Although any stoppage for Tagliafico would have had little bearing on the outcome, Argentina appeared hopeful it might prompt officials to revisit the sequence that led to Fernandez's dismissal.The effort had no effect, with Fernandez's red card standing and Argentina forced to see out the remainder of the match with 10 players.Scaloni initially reshuffled his side by asking Julian Alvarez to drop deeper and help cover the numerical disadvantage. As Spain continued to dominate possession and territory, the Argentina coach eventually introduced an additional defender, leaving Messi increasingly isolated in attack.Spain's pressure was rewarded early in extra time when substitute Ferran Torres found the net in the 106th minute, sealing a historic World Cup triumph.Tempers flared once the final whistle blew. Nahuel Molina appeared to strike Spain captain Rodri in the torso during the celebrations, while Leandro Paredes grabbed Eric Garcia by the throat before pushing Gavi to the ground, sparking a heated confrontation involving players from both teams.The ugly scenes drew strong criticism from former England defender Micah Richards, who questioned Argentina's behaviour after the defeat."It's embarrassing. They were on the cusp every single time. Seeing that sort of stuff after the game was played, it's not good, it's embarrassing to be honest. Paredes is better than that. We all know what it's like to lose a game but this is not good enough."Former England captain Wayne Rooney also criticised Argentina's reaction, saying the conduct reflected frustration after being second best on the night."We've seen this from Argentina before. It's just sad, very poor from them. If you lose a game of football, be graceful. It's a reaction to them being outplayed. Enzo Fernandez has got what he deserves."
Article Summary: Argentina lost 1-0 to Spain in the FIFA World Cup final in New York. Ferran Torres scored the winner in the 106th minute to hand Spain their second World Cup title. Much of the post-match discussion has centred on Argentina's conduct. New footage appears to show an attempt to influence the aftermath of Enzo Fernandez's red card.

Article Title: Hard Knocks trailer: Inside the Seattle Seahawks' mission to make NFL history with a Super Bowl repeat

Seahawks' HBO 'Hard Knocks' Trailer (Getty Images and HBO)

Why is the Seahawks' Hard Knocks season historic?

What storylines should fans watch in Seahawks training camp 2026?

HBO's Hard Knocks released the first trailer for its upcoming season with the Seattle Seahawks on Tuesday, and it sets the tone immediately. Head coach Mike Macdonald is seen addressing his players with barely contained energy: "Men, you are champions!" What follows is a five-episode series that will track whether that title stays in Seattle. The show premieres August 4 at 9 p.m. ET on HBO and HBO Max, one week earlier than originally scheduled, with new episodes running every Tuesday through September 1.This is the first time since the very first Hard Knocks season in 2001 -- which followed the Baltimore Ravens -- that the show has trained its cameras on a defending Super Bowl champion. That alone makes it different from every other edition in the show's 25-year history. The Seahawks are also first-timers on the series, which adds another layer to an already unusual setup.Macdonald's message in the trailer acknowledges the difficulty of what comes next. "You have done it through our mentality of every freaking day," he tells his players. "Next year, that's what it's gonna take." It's a coach who knows that winning once is hard. Winning back-to-back is a different kind of pressure entirely, and the cameras will be there for all of it.Training camp opens in Renton, Washington on July 25, with rookies reporting on July 27 and veterans arriving July 24. The Hard Knocks crew will be embedded through August 13, capturing five weeks of competition, roster decisions, and everything that happens behind closed doors before the regular season begins.Sam Darnold returns at quarterback alongside Jaxon Smith-Njigba, who signed a contract extension after earning AP NFL Offensive Player of the Year honours in 2025. Those two are the offensive spine of a team coming off a 29-13 Super Bowl win over the New England Patriots.The more pressing question is at running back. Zach Charbonnet is recovering from ACL surgery and his availability remains uncertain. First-round pick Jadarian Price could be pushed into a starting role sooner than anyone anticipated. The right guard competition and the backup quarterback race are two more battles that will unfold on camera -- exactly the kind of subplot Hard Knocks has always done well.The preseason schedule gives the season a natural arc. The Seahawks host Dallas on August 15, travel to Nashville for a joint practice with the Titans on August 21, and then close out the preseason against Kansas City on August 28. The Hard Knocks finale airs September 8 -- one day before Seattle hosts New England in a Super Bowl LX rematch to kick off the regular season.

Article Title: Fact check: Did Kayla Nicole really say she is still in contact with Travis Kelce despite his wedding to Taylor Swift?
Article Text:
Fact check: Viral Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce and Kayla Nicole wedding post is false

Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce tied the knot on July 3 at Madison Square Garden

A viral social media post has once again dragged Taylor Swift Travis Kelce , and Kayla Nicole into an online controversy. This time, users claimed Nicole broke down in tears after allegedly being denied an invitation to Swift and Kelce's wedding. The post quickly gained traction, but there is no credible evidence to support those claims. Here's what actually happened and why the rumor has spread so widely.A post shared by the X account InstantCap claimed Kayla Nicole became emotional after Taylor Swift allegedly blocked her from attending the wedding she shared with Travis Kelce. The post also attributed several dramatic statements to Nicole, including:> “Travis and I are still very good friends that hangout and party so it hurt me”> “She is jealous of what we have”> “I will always be here for Travis. She can’t stop me”The post attracted significant attention online, collecting hundreds of thousands of views and prompting heated discussions among fans. However, there is no verified interview, podcast episode, video, or reliable report in which Nicole made those remarks.The claim falls apart under closer scrutiny. Several users in the comment section themselves questioned the authenticity of the quotes, with one asking, "So where in this clip did she say that?" That reaction reflects the biggest issue with the viral post. It presents alleged quotations without providing any supporting footage or credible source.At the time of writing, neither Kayla Nicole nor representatives for Taylor Swift or Travis Kelce have addressed the viral claim. No established entertainment or sports news outlet has reported that Nicole was barred from the wedding or made the statements circulating online.Like many celebrity rumors, the story appears to have spread because it involved three high-profile names with a well-known history. But popularity on social media does not make a claim factual. Readers should treat such posts with caution until they are backed by verifiable evidence.Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce officially tied the knot on July 3rd, in a star-studded ceremony at Madison Square Garden. It was one of the most talked-about celebrity weddings of the year, and garnered a huge amount of attention from fans of music, sports and entertainment.Several big names from the NFL and entertainment worlds and family members, close friends were present at the ceremony, reports said. Fans followed every update from the celebration eagerly, but speculation about the guest list also fueled a wave of misinformation online.That’s when the fake Kayla Nicole rumor began to explode. Likely could be a young Travis Kelce for the New York Giants’ offense.Malik Nabers is recovering, and the Giants could divert their attention to Likely.How Likely paired with Mark Andrews in the Baltimore Ravens. He could do the same in New York.“Be very patient with Malik Nabers,” Clark said in the clip.“And I believe Isaiah Likely could be a huge reason why you can be patient.When you think about the way [Likely] was paired with Mark Andrews in Baltimore, he was the guy that gave you the explosive play that could stretch you down the seam.And now with Jaxson Dart to give him an outlet that’s closer to the line of scrimmage, that’s closer to the tackle box.I believe [former Kansas City Chiefs offensive coordinator and current Giants OC] Matt Nagy understands how to utilize a tight end.He could have a young Travis Kelce effect for this New York Giants offense.I believe he is just waiting to be unleashed.You add [tight end] Theo Johnson to that, who is already in New York, who we’ve seen make some athletic plays on the outside.But it could also be an inline blocking tight end along with the 21 personnel [one tight end formation].We could see some of that 12 [two tight-end], and then also incorporating [full back] Patrick Ricard.So, we can get those big packages along with Cam Skattebo that were huge in Baltimore.”The 1-minute-long video went viral on X. A post read, “ESPN’s last straw with this dude’s takes.”Another wrote, “Calling Isaiah Likely prime Travis Kelce is grounds for firing.”A user commented, “Adam [Schefter] was looking annoyed he just got the text Ryan Clark is fired hurry up this his last show [face palm emoji]...Adam [Schefter] just got extended a few weeks ago.”Adam Schefter signed a multi-year contract extension with Worldwide Leader in Sports, ESPN; ESPN announced on July 13.The contract keeps Schefter with the network into the 2030s.Apart from his social media presence and news-breaking, Schefter will regularly appear on “Sunday NFL Countdown,” “Monday Night Countdown,”“NFL Live,” “The Pat McAfee Show,” “SportsCenter,” “Get Up,” “First Take,” and the network’s Super Bowl 61 and NFL Draft coverage.“Adam [Schefter] reaches NFL fans wherever they are, on air, on ESPN Digital and on social,” ESPN President of Content Burke Magnus said in a statement.“And that multi-platform instinct is a big part of what makes him so valuable to us.ESPN NFL news has a way of cutting through everything else on the sports calendar, and Adam is a big reason our audience comes to ESPN first when it breaks.His credibility with sources, relentless work ethic and ability to deliver news in real time are second to none.Fans know it, the league knows it, and we know it. We’re thrilled he’ll continue leading our NFL coverage for years to come.”Adam Schefter’s previous deal with ESPN roughly gave him $9 million per year, New York Post reported in 2022.As for Ryan Clark?After parting ways with ESPN, he will continue his media career through his current independent role in The Pivot Podcast,which he hosts alongside co-hosts Channing Crowder and Fred Taylor[we could expect an episode on why he was fired, or how he was fired mid-broadcast, just speculation here],and his hosting role in Inside the NFL [which he joined in Sept. 2023].Now, why was Clark fired from ESPN?According to The Athletic’s Andrew Marchand, Ryan Clark was making more than $2 million per year in ESPN.He had been with the network for more than a decade. He was slated to be a larger part of ESPN’s Super Bowl LXI coverage in 2027.The network is slated to broadcast the event for the first time in 2027.But The Athletic’s sources said that there had been internal talks since February 2026 that Clark would not return.ESPN executives took issue with his comments to Peter Schrager.On ESPN’s “Get Up” Sept. 2025 segment,Peter Schrager was defending Dallas Cowboys wide receiver CeeDee Lamb’s performance in an opening night loss, when Clark told him,“We shouldn’t do this on TV, so I apologize if people think this is rude: that’s the non-player in you.”Peter Schrager is not an NFL player. But Clark has played in the NFL.Clark reportedly pointed out that a non-NFL player wouldn’t understand that a team’s result is more crucial than an individual performance.“Oh stop! Don’t belittle me like that,” Schrager responded.“I can come and say, as three ex-players are saying one thing, and give an alternative perspective that maybe CeeDee Lamb did play well.”“What I need for you to do, what I need for you to do, is not get mad and let me finish for once. He was signed by the New York Giants in 2002. He played two seasons for them as a safety.Then in 2004 and 2005, he played for the Washington Redskins. Then from 2006 to 2013, he played for the Pittsburgh Steelers.Then in 2014, he played for the Washington Redskins. He is a Super Bowl XLIII champion and a one-time Pro Bowler.Over the years, Clark has collected 938 total tackles, 4 sacks, 16 interceptions, and 4 forced fumbles.His total career earnings over 13 NFL seasons are $23 million.Clark retired from professional football in February 2015. Article Title: NFL’s gambling policy explained: How one wrong bet can wipe out a player’s NFL season
Article Text:
The NFL gambling policy restricts what players can wager on, where they can gamble and how they handle private team information. (Image via Getty)

The 6 NFL gambling rules every player must follow

1. Never bet on the NFL, including the draft and awards

2. Do not use another person to place a bet

3. Do not gamble at work or during team travel

4. Keep inside information private

5. Stay out of sportsbooks during the playing season

6. Daily fantasy football is off-limits

How NFL gambling violations become suspensions or permanent bans

The NFL’s gambling rules are simple at the top and surprisingly specific underneath. Players cannot wager on the NFL under any circumstances. They can legally bet on some other sports, but a permitted wager can become a violation based on where and when they place it.The league’s latest broad public reminder came on Oct. 24, 2025, when the NFL and NFL Players Association again circulated the policy to players. As of July 2026, the rules continue to draw clear lines around NFL betting, workplace gambling, inside information, sportsbooks and fantasy contests.NFL players cannot bet on any NFL game, regardless of whether their team is involved. The restriction also covers the NFL Draft, NFL Combine, Pro Bowl and NFL Honors.Players can receive injury updates, role changes and other team information before the public. The ban removes any financial incentive tied to an NFL outcome and protects the league from questions about whether private knowledge influenced a wager.A player cannot ask a relative, friend or anyone else to make a prohibited wager for him. The NFL classifies that conduct as third-party or proxy betting.The account holder does not change who controls the wager. Using someone else’s account can lead to an indefinite suspension of at least one year, the same minimum attached to several direct NFL betting violations.Players may legally wager on non-NFL sports when they are away from work, but location changes the rule. Gambling is prohibited at team facilities and stadiums, during road trips and inside team hotels. The restriction covers sports wagers, casino games and card games.A legal basketball wager placed from a player’s home can be allowed. Placing that same wager from the team facility can result in discipline because the player is on club property and working.Players cannot share confidential information about an NFL game, player, team or league event with a third party. That can include injuries, lineup decisions, playing time, personnel moves and other details the team has not announced.The player does not need to place a bet to violate this rule. Giving another person information that could affect a betting market can trigger an indefinite suspension of at least one year.NFL players cannot enter a sportsbook during the playing season. They may pass through the area to reach another part of a casino, but they cannot enter the sportsbook to place wagers or conduct betting business.​Casino gambling on personal time remains permitted when the player is away from club property and team travel. The sportsbook ban limits contact with betting operations while the season is active.Daily fantasy football contests are prohibited because their prizes depend on short-term player performances. The NFL treats that format differently from a low-stakes league among friends.Players can participate in traditional fantasy football leagues when the total prize does not exceed $250. The policy permits limited recreational play while barring daily contests tied to weekly or single-game results.Betting on an NFL game carries an indefinite suspension of at least one year. The minimum rises to two years when the wager involves the player’s own team. Actual or attempted game fixing can result in permanent banishment from the NFL.The NFL applies the same minimum one-year indefinite suspension to sharing inside information and arranging a proxy wager. When deciding the final punishment, the commissioner can consider the pattern of wagers, access to confidential information and the player’s ability to affect a game. Cooperation, self-reporting and accepting responsibility can reduce the penalty.Workplace betting on another sport follows a separate scale. The first violation carries a two-game suspension without pay. A second violation brings six games without pay. A third can lead to a suspension of at least one year.The policy is stricter for coaches, executives, scouts, officials and other league or club employees. Those personnel cannot bet on sports. Players receive a limited route to wager on non-NFL events away from work, while staff members do not.The NFL has also increased enforcement through education and monitoring. In-person gambling training became mandatory for players in 2024. The league added former players to its education program in 2025 and said it trains more than 20,000 people each year, including players, coaches, officials, medical workers and sideline staff.For players, every wager comes down to the event, location and timing. Betting on basketball from home may be permitted. Betting on the same game from a team hotel is not. Betting on the NFL carries the longest suspensions because it creates a direct conflict between a player’s job and his financial interest.
Article Summary: The NFL’s gambling rules are simple at the top and surprisingly specific underneath. Players cannot wager on the NFL under any circumstances. They can legally bet on some other sports, but a permitted wager can become a violation based on where and when they place it. The league has increased enforcement through education and monitoring.

Article Title: “I don’t take lightly”: Stephen Curry breaks silence on historic Hall of Fame news with heartfelt admission
Article Text:
Stephen Curry. Image via: Bob Kupbens-Imagn Images

Naismith Hall of Fame breaks tradition with historic Stephen Curry announcement

What Stephen Curry said about the historic Hall of Fame news

Stephen Curry's Warriors legacy

Category Detail Warriors tenure Since 2009 draft, entering 18th season NBA championships 4 (2015, 2017, 2018, 2022) MVP awards 2 All-Star selections 12 Career 3-pointers made NBA all-time leader

Stephen Curry's Hall of Fame future became present tense on Tuesday, when the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame announced its first career exhibit built around an active player. The feature, called "Stephen Curry: Beyond the Arc," opens Friday at the museum in Springfield, Massachusetts.The exhibit covers Curry's path from an overlooked Davidson recruit to the NBA's all-time 3-point leader, using video, memorabilia and first-hand storytelling assembled with his Thirty Ink team. Golden State's four-time champion and two-time MVP is still playing, which makes the timing of the honor unusual for a museum nearing its 75th year.The Hall of Fame said Curry will become the first active NBA player to receive a standalone exhibit in the museum's nearly 75-year history. The gallery pulls together rarely seen footage, memorabilia and first-person storytelling from across his career, built in partnership with Thirty Ink.Hall of Fame president and CEO John Doleva called the timing meaningful. "This is truly a historic moment for us and for basketball fans worldwide," Doleva said, framing Curry's involvement while still active as a rare step for the institution and adding that Curry has set a standard for what it means to be a role model both on and off the court.Curry addressed the honor directly in a statement tied to the announcement, saying the recognition is something he doesn't take lightly. He pointed to the people who believed in him and the work that happened when nobody was watching as the foundation of the moment.The four-time champion said he hopes fans walk away from the exhibit feeling the joy and gratitude basketball has given him, and see pieces of their own path reflected in his story. It's a personal framing for a player who has spent nearly two decades building a résumé most never approach.Curry has never worn another NBA jersey since Golden State drafted him in 2009, and he's entering his 18th season with the franchise. Paired with Klay Thompson as the "Splash Brothers" under former coach Mark Jackson, he helped remake the league's shooting identity years before it became standard.Steve Kerr took over for the 2014-15 season, and with Draymond Green anchoring the defense, the Warriors went 67-15 and beat LeBron James and Cleveland for the franchise's first title of the Curry era. Kevin Durant's arrival produced back-to-back titles in 2017 and 2018, and the core group returned to win a fourth championship together in 2022.Warriors general manager Mike Dunleavy framed the exhibit as a preview of what's still ahead. "This is only a prelude to his eventual induction in Springfield," Dunleavy said, calling Curry an amazing human being who has single-handedly changed the game.The exhibit is expected to run through the summer of 2027 before it closes, giving fans more than a year to see it in person. Curry's formal induction still sits years away, since Hall of Fame rules require four full retired seasons before a player's name goes on the ballot. For now, Springfield has decided his story is worth telling while he's still writing it.
Article Summary: The Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame announced its first career exhibit built around an active player. The feature, called "Stephen Curry: Beyond the Arc," opens Friday at the museum in Springfield, Massachusetts. The exhibit covers Curry's path from an overlooked Davidson recruit to the NBA's all-time 3-point leader.

Why P.J. Washington's situation has put the Mavericks under pressure

P.J. Washington's reported reunion bid with the Los Angeles Lakers has hit a real roadblock, with a fresh report pouring cold water on any meaningful trade momentum between the two sides. Washington, who signed a four-year, $88.76 million extension with Dallas last September, had been floated as a natural fit next to his former Mavericks teammate Luka Doncic in Los Angeles.The optimism looks premature now. Despite an earlier report of a Lakers front-office inquiry, the latest word from league insiders suggests there is no real trade infrastructure in place, leaving the reunion talk firmly in speculation territory for now.P.J. Washington has been one of the more expensive role players in Dallas after signing his extension, and he is entering its first season carrying real trade value given his production. He averaged 14.2 points, 7.0 rebounds and 1.8 assists across 56 games last season, shooting 45% from the field and 32.5% from three, while playing 31 minutes a night as a two-way forward.The Mavericks have also created a crowded frontcourt after matching a two-year offer sheet for Moussa Cisse, adding to a group that includes Dereck Lively II and Santi Aldama.Daniel Gafford has already been confirmed as available, with NBA insider Marc Stein reporting Dallas is "still fielding offers" for the center, and Washington's name has drifted into similar territory even though the Mavericks have shown far less urgency to move him.An earlier report indicated the Lakers had reached out to Dallas about Washington, hoping to pair him with Doncic and Austin Reaves after LeBron James' departure left a hole at forward. A framework involving Bronny James, Jarred Vanderbilt and a 2032 first-round pick swap was floated as the shape a deal could take.But NBA insider Jake Fischer has since dismissed the idea that talks have gone anywhere close to real. He said, "I know Lakers fans want to keep drawing the line to a trade with Dallas for either PJ Washington or Gafford because of their success with Luka Doncic. I really don't have any inclination that the Lakers had trade talks with either of those guys of real consequence this offseason," Fischer said That leaves the Lakers' pursuit stuck at the speculative stage. Dallas, for its part, has reportedly shown little appetite to move Washington specifically, preferring to explore deals involving other veterans first.If the deal ever materializes, Washington gives the Lakers a proven complementary piece next to Doncic, someone who can defend multiple positions and space the floor without needing touches. That fit was the entire basis for the earlier report linking the two sides.The financial piece remains the bigger obstacle regardless of how the rumor mill reads it. The Lakers would need to send out at least $11.8 million in salary to satisfy matching rules, which is why names like Bronny James and Vanderbilt were attached to the framework in the first place rather than a cleaner swap.Dallas would be trading long-term money for youth and future capital, adding a low-cost developmental piece in Bronny James and defensive depth in Vanderbilt, both of which fit a roster increasingly built around Cooper Flagg. The 2032 first-round pick swap adds a future asset without addressing anything immediate.Given the latest reporting suggests Dallas isn't actively shopping Washington the way it is Gafford, the Mavericks currently have little reason to engage with this package at all.The fit for the Lakers is real, but the latest reporting suggests this reunion talk is running well ahead of any actual trade momentum. Until Dallas shows real willingness to move Washington, this stays a fan-driven storyline more than a live negotiation.
Article Summary: P.J. Washington's reported reunion bid with the Los Angeles Lakers has hit a real roadblock. An earlier report indicated the Lakers had reached out to Dallas about Washington, hoping to pair him with Luka Doncic. A framework involving Bronny James, Jarred Vanderbilt and a 2032 first-round pick swap was floated as the shape a deal could take. NBA insider Jake Fischer has since dismissed the idea that talks have gone anywhere close to real.

Article Title: 15-time Lakers legend sends clear message to LeBron James’ team decision amid chaotic free agency
Article Text:
LeBron James. Image via: Roy Rochlin/ Getty Images for Fanatics

Shaquille O'Neal reacts to LeBron James' free agency drama

Shocking personal reason behind LeBron James' Lakers signing comes to light, sending fans into a frenzy Image via: Al Bello/ Getty Images

Patrick Beverley reveals that his source lied about LeBron James' decision

LeBron James is still taking it slow

LeBron James' free agency decision is still unresolved more than a month after he informed the Los Angeles Lakers he would not return as an unrestricted free agent. His agent, Rich Paul, said this week that the four-time MVP will not be rushed into picking his next team, leaving five franchises in limbo.Shaquille O'Neal has now weighed in on where his former teammate should land, and Patrick Beverley had to walk back a false report that briefly sent fans into a frenzy over a decision that never came.O'Neal believes James will ultimately chase a fifth championship ring wherever he signs, floating Miami, Golden State and Philadelphia as realistic landing spots given how few playing years James has left. The Hall of Famer also pushed back on the idea that James left the Lakers on bad terms, framing it instead as a front office decision to build around Luka Doncic rather than a locker room fracture."Knowing LeBron, he is going to go somewhere he can win another ring— Miami, Golden State, maybe even Philly. What we realized toward the end of our careers is that once we're done, we can never play again. You never want to retire and say, 'I should have done this, I should have done that.' He still has two or three years left, I think, so kudos to him for trying to align himself with a team where he can win another championship,” Shaq said in his recent appearance on Extra's.Asked about a possible reunion in Cleveland, O'Neal said finishing his career where it started would carry real weight. He closed with a simple well-wish for his former teammate: "But I wish him well. Every team he goes to, I know it's going to be exciting, and I hope he can win his fifth ring."Beverley claimed James would reveal his decision on Monday, a report that spread fast given his ties to the league. When Monday passed with no announcement, Beverley admitted the tip was bad, posting on X: "Can't believe that source lied to me man."The retraction reveals how little verified information is actually circulating around James' camp right now. Rich Paul has stayed guarded in every public appearance, and no outlet, including Beverley's source, has produced a confirmed timeline.James has given suitors little to work with beyond telling fans at Fanatics Fest last week that he "won't hold you guys up too much longer." Paul said the calls from interested teams asking if there's more they should be doing have all gotten the same answer: "We're not going to be rushed."Even NBA commissioner Adam Silver has acknowledged the league is holding off on finalizing next season's schedule until James signs. Paul isn't pretending to have inside knowledge of the timing either, saying the call could come in minutes or could stretch on much longer. Until it does, five franchises and a national broadcast schedule stay on hold.
Article Summary: Shaquille O'Neal believes LeBron James will chase a fifth championship ring wherever he signs. The Hall of Famer also pushed back on the idea that James left the Lakers on bad terms. Patrick Beverley had to walk back a false report that briefly sent fans into a frenzy over a decision that never came.
